formulation: EDP = E[E] * E[L] = (E_1 + r_bar * E_2) * (L_1 + r_bar * L_2)

definitions.E_1: Nominal computational energy index of primary model M_1 (normalized FLOPs / compute scale)
definitions.E_2: Nominal computational energy index of secondary heavy model M_2 (normalized FLOPs / compute scale)
definitions.r_bar: Expected heavy model invocation probability E[r(x)] in [0, 1]

governance_rule: The manuscript explicitly defines EDP as a normalized theoretical metric for Pareto frontier characterization, with zero claims of physical oscilloscope power measurements.
